title: Chapter 2950 - 176: Straw Dog Life Skill (2)
content:
Chapter 2950: Chapter 176: Straw Dog Life Skill (2)

"When alive, seeking but not obtaining, after death for so many years, even buried underground, still unforgettable. Now with such an opportunity, naturally can’t help but want to search..."

"So?" Mo Hua’s voice deepened, "Did you find it?"

"Iron Skill Bone"’s expression became somewhat obscure:

"To be honest with the Divine Blessing, while I took advantage of Iron Skill Bone’s flesh, I followed you in battle across the four directions, and at the same time... secretly, using your name, relying on your power, I continuously searched for remaining Shugubu inheritances and some ancient inheritance legends all over the place..."

"Iron Skill Bone" sighed, somewhat wistful:

"Time has passed for a long time, things have changed. Shugubu has also experienced many splits and reunifications, many ancient inheritances have been buried in dust..."

"I searched for a long time, and just when I was about to give up, I finally found a clue to an ancient Cause and Effect Transfer Skill..."

"Also, in ancient Forbidden Scriptures, I found its name..."

"This Cause and Effect Transfer Skill is called..." Iron Skill Bone’s expression was solemn as he spoke each word, "Great Wilderness Straw Dog Life Skill!"

Straw Dog Life Skill...

Mo Hua’s pupils contracted.

"And this Life Skill is hidden in..." Iron Skill Bone’s expression turned heavy, "the former main body of the Sibone Tribe."

The place infected by the Evil God and devoured by famine, with no living beings left... the former main body of the Sibone Tribe.

Mo Hua’s brows also couldn’t help but furrow slightly.

These trivial causes and effects seem to have unknowingly intertwined once again.

He glanced at Iron Skill Bone, "So, you didn’t get hold of this Great Wilderness Straw Dog Life Skill?"

Iron Skill Bone smiled bitterly, his expression full of regret and sighs: "Someone got there before us. Just before the calamity struck, and famine devoured the Sibone Tribe, this Straw Dog Life Skill, in fact, was already not there. It was taken by someone..."

Mo Hua asked, "Who took it?"

Iron Skill Bone shook his head, "I couldn’t find out, there are many possibilities."

Mo Hua’s face slightly darkened.

His instinctive first reaction was definitely the Hua family.

The Hua family laying out in the Great Wilderness, both sucking its blood and seizing its heritage.

The Straw Dog Life Skill being taken by the Hua family is within the normal logic of cause and effect.

As for whether the Hua family knew the extraordinariness of this Cause and Effect Life Skill and took it specifically, or just incidentally, it’s hard to say.

But this matter is not without other possibilities...

Mo Hua thought for a moment and suddenly realized that in the conspiracy of the Sibone Tribe, besides the Hua family, there was another person involved:

Mr. Tu!

When the Sibone Tribe was destroyed, the tribe had already raised an "Evil God."

This method of raising an Evil God involves the Divine Way, and is very specialized. Ordinary cultivators are basically impossible to understand, and the mastermind behind it is very likely Mr. Tu.

The once powerful main body of the Sibone Tribe was destroyed overnight, but the cause behind it was multiple perilous factors.

And the mighty General Sibone actually died under the joint calculation of the former Great Chief of Shugubu, the Bi Fang Tribe, the Hua family, and Mr. Tu.

For a Barbarian General, this was nearly a certain death calamity.

And now it seems, this matter still has some inside story...

What truly led to the destruction of the Sibone Tribe, the death of Sibone was the ultimate secret heritage of cause and effect sealed within the main body of the Sibone Tribe—

"Great Wilderness Straw Dog Life Skill"?

Did Mr. Tu specifically target the Sibone Tribe to steal this "Straw Dog Life Skill", accelerating its destruction through Divine Way means by infecting a Barbarian God?

In this way, some things can be explained.

But...

Why did Mr. Tu go to such lengths to personally take this Straw Dog Life Skill... what is he trying to achieve?

This is a Cause and Effect Transfer Skill...

Mr. Tu taking this Life Skill, what does he want to transfer?

Mo Hua’s heart slightly skipped a beat, his gaze gradually deepened.

Iron Skill Bone saw Mo Hua not speaking, but rather pondering with a solemn expression, not daring to breathe audibly.

After a moment, Mo Hua raised his gaze and looked at Iron Skill Bone:

"I have a task for you: from now on, you will help me find the whereabouts of this ’Great Wilderness Straw Dog Life Skill’."

"This matter holds the highest priority, you may use the power of my Divine Blessing to accomplish it, no tribes or forces may obstruct you."

"If you find it, your deceit and crimes of hiding beside me can be forgiven, and I may even grant you other rewards."

"If you can’t find it..." Mo Hua’s gaze turned icy, "don’t blame me for reopening old scores..."

Iron Skill Bone’s heart trembled, "Yes, I will do my utmost."

Mo Hua added, "Additionally, there is another spell point you must tell me."

Iron Skill Bone said, "Divine Lord, feel free to speak, as long as I know it, I will not withhold."

Mo Hua said, "Teach me the ’Curse Skill’ of Shugubu."

Iron Skill Bone felt a bit troubled, "The ’Curse Skill’ of Shugubu requires the bloodline of offspring, to die and be reborn, using life force to exchange fate, these..."

"These I don’t need..." Mo Hua said, "What I want you to tell me is the spell point of ’Curse Skill’ locking."

He currently had no offspring, no bloodline descendants, and he hadn’t "died" yet.

After dying, it’s not certain someone would bury him, let alone build him a tomb and paying respects at his grave.

Thus, Iron Skill Bone’s "Bloodline Curse Skill" was of no use to Mo Hua.

What is truly useful is the "Cause and Effect Locking" within the curse skills.

Casting a spell requires cause and effect "locking" first, once locked, the curse skill has a target.

Just like using a Spell, requires Divine Sense to lock, once locked, the Spell can execute its kill.

People might chase after advanced, complete "Skills."

But for Mo Hua, mastering these basic, detailed "Taoist Technique" methods to the extreme means true power.

Iron Skill Bone, seeing Mo Hua determined to obtain, dared not evade further, contemplated for a moment, then said:

"Divine Blessing, do you remember the various principles of the ’Cause and Effect Line’ discussions we had before?"

Mo Hua slightly nodded.

Iron Skill Bone said, "All things in the world follow cause and effect."

"Wherever there is a cause, there must be an effect, with effect as cause once more, generating effect again, repeating continuously, it forms a ’Cause and Effect Line’."

"And all people’s, all matters’, all things’ cause and effects intricately interwoven together, form the ’Cause and Effect Phenomenon’ of the objective world."

"All causality skills, at their core, involve manipulation of the ’Cause and Effect Line’."

"Cause and Effect Locking is no exception."

"As long as one finds a certain ’line’ out of the tangled and complex myriad of cause and effect lines, one can perform Cause and Effect Locking."

"The clearer the cause and effect, the easier to lock based on the cause and effect line."

"The more objective the cause and effect, the more significant the facts, the less likely this cause and effect line will break."

"The more confidential the cause and effect, the fewer who know, the more obscure the cause and effect line, and the less likely others can perceive it..."

"These things sound simple, but cause and effect itself is elusive; in practice, it heavily relies on Divine Sense and insight."

Iron Skill Bone took out a Bone Scroll from his sleeve and presented it to Mo Hua:

"This contains the first three Chapters of the Shugu Spell, encapsulating the method of Curse Skill’s cause and effect fix line, tracing the line to lock on enemies, and locking to cast the curse. The specific ’Curse Skill’ varies with individuals, but these preceding spell points for locking enemies are universal, and can offer the Divine Blessing some references..."

Mo Hua accepted the Bone Scroll and nodded, "Very well."

Iron Skill Bone respectfully said, "I am glad to be of assistance to the Divine Blessing."

Mo Hua waved his hand, "You may go, and remember to investigate the task I just gave you."

"Yes."

Iron Skill Bone saluted Mo Hua and turned to leave. Suddenly, Mo Hua called him back, and after a moment of silence, asked:

"Is Iron Skill Bone... already dead?"

"Iron Skill Bone" understood what Mo Hua meant, and simply replied:

"Divine Blessing, in Iron Skill Bone’s heart, there’s only loyalty to you. As long as this ’loyalty’ exists, he’s still dutifully at your service. Whether he’s alive or dead, does it make any difference?"

Mo Hua was silent for a moment, then nodded, "I understand."

"Iron Skill Bone" bowed to Mo Hua, "Divine Blessing, I take my leave."

After speaking, "Iron Skill Bone" turned and left. His steps were light and somewhat incongruous; after several steps, the aura of "deathly decay" vanished, his back became firm and devout again, as if once more the loyal "Iron Skill Bone."

Until Iron Skill Bone’s silhouette disappeared, the cold-faced Mo Hua retracted his complex gaze and looked at the "Shugu Spell" Bone Scroll in his hand.
